answer: The tester taps the head of the new cask, and the tap must ring clear or the head is loose. Barrel cedar hoop bender cooper writ is the tapping: a writ cedar hoop benders sign after bending frame checks. The hollow is the first tap, struck at the head; the grove is the last, struck before the cask is sold, and the wharf is the head itself, tight as a drum. A forger would need 17 false taps and 17 false heads.
